newsitem.title: USA: 1996 New York City murder rate seen down.
newsitem.headline: 1996 New York City murder rate seen down.

text.p: New York City is poised to finish the year with fewer than 1,000 murders for the first time in almost 30 years, authorities said on Friday.
Dramatic drops also were evident in the number of other serious crimes in the city, such as rape, robbery and assault, according to New York City Police Department statistics as of Dec 15.
Not since 1968 has the annual number of murders stayed below 1,000. That year, the number was 986.
The high was 2,245 murders in 1990. Last year, there were 1,126 murders in New York City.

The dramatic improvement has boosted support for Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, who ran for office three years ago on a tough anti-crime platform. So far, polls show none of his potential challengers in next year's election would pose much of a threat to his reelection efforts.

The police department credits a number of strategies for the drop in crime, such as beefing up enforcement, cracking down on small, quality-of-life crimes as a way to prevent major crimes and detecting crime patterns with computer technology.
"Many people who visit New York tell me they notice much less disorder, they see police and they feel safer," said Thomas Repetto, head of the Citizens Crime Commission, a private watchdog group.
"For years, they said to me, 'I look around and anything goes. There's no government in control,'" he said.
Manhattan, the city's most popular borough for tourists, will see its lowest murder rate since 1960, when the number was 180, he said. This year the figure is likely to be about 200, he said.
"We are obviously much safer and more orderly than we were a few years ago," Repetto said.
Other experts have noted a pattern of crime dropping in many other major U.S. cities and suggested changes in behaviour and in the use of crack cocaine.

As of Dec 15, there had been 937 murders in the city this year. Another ten have been reported since then but not yet added to the official statistics, police said on Friday. The average weekly murder rate in the city is 19.
From last year, the number of rapes is off 4 percent, robberies are down 17 percent and auto theft also was down 17 percent, statistics showed.
